note: Papers the extractor found to fail the inclusion bar on reading the full text, despite passing screening. Kept out of the site build (build_site.py skips them) until a scope ruling. Resolution: either exclude (move verdict to excluded.json, delete the record) or keep (remove from this list). Added by hand from extractor reports.

papers.2005hsieh: Therapeutic ultrasound to an arthritic ankle joint; no neural tissue targeted (condition C).
papers.2020khan: Perspective/rationale article with no original experiment (condition A).
papers.2022kima: Bench-top radiation-force characterisation in a water tank and glass tube; nothing neural sonicated (condition C).
papers.1984gavrilov: Review of the group's earlier work; the extractor recovered two sub-studies with parameters, but no original exposure is reported in this paper (condition A).
papers.2021blackmore: Scanning ultrasound with microbubbles is BBB opening (E4); only the SUS-alone arm would qualify. Check whether that arm sonicated with modulation intent.
papers.2023olinger: MR thermometry validation; the ultrasound prototype was never energised, so no exposure occurred (condition A/C).
papers.2023kook: Device engineering paper; the CMUT was unpowered in the only live-animal test, so no neural exposure occurred (condition C).
papers.2024horii: Cochlear physiology preprint: ultrasound delivered to the guinea pig ear by bone conduction and ossicle stimulation. Sensory organ, and audition rather than neuromodulation intent; check against conditions C and D.
papers.2024shindo: LIPUS dose-finding on cultured endothelial cells (HUVEC, cerebrovascular endothelium) plus skull transmittance; no neural tissue sonicated (condition C).
papers.2025zhu: Invokes tFUS throughout but the methods describe only passive EEG and EMG recording during a grasping task; no ultrasound device, parameters or exposure are reported (condition A).
papers.2025zhang: Implanted ferroelectric heterojunction device in the PVN; check whether the stimulus reaching tissue is ultrasound or an ultrasound-powered electrical implant (E5).
papers.2025oliveira: In vitro device-validation paper on osteoblasts, chondrocytes and fibroblasts with one neuronal-like line (N2a); check whether the neural arm satisfies conditions C and D.
papers.2025karthickraghunath: Proposes a closed-loop tFUS imaging framework validated only by simulation and by re-analysing unrelated public fMRI and NIRS datasets; no subject or tissue was exposed to ultrasound (condition A). Several comparison tables read as illustrative rather than measured.
papers.2026rezai: A letter clarifying a serious adverse event in a trial reported elsewhere; the letter itself reports no original exposure (condition A), though its safety content may belong in the key documents list.
papers.2019nakanishi: Airborne inaudible (>20 kHz) sound from a loudspeaker, not a transducer coupled to tissue; the extractor could not place a target or a carrier frequency (conditions B and C).
papers.1957bowsher: High-intensity focused ultrasound producing lesions in mouse spinal cord; the endpoint is tissue damage, not modulated function (condition D).
papers.1981borrelli: Ultrasound damage to cat brain synapses; the endpoint is tissue damage (condition D).
papers.2001imaizumi: Bone-conducted ultrasound perception in deaf subjects, a hearing-pathway study delivered via vibrator; dose only in dB SPL (conditions B and D).
papers.2006wu: Bat inferior-colliculus echo-duration selectivity with airborne ultrasonic tone pips: auditory-physiology stimulus, not neuromodulation (condition D).
papers.2007du: Rat cochlear-nucleus evoked potentials to airborne ultrasonic tone pips: auditory-physiology stimulus (condition D).
papers.2016hung: Therapeutic ultrasound plus treadmill training after peripheral nerve injury; endpoint is recovery and repair (E9).
papers.2024hacker: Wearable auricular ultrasonic vagus nerve stimulator: device engineering and bench safety, no subjects or physiological readout (condition C).
papers.2026yinnicholaschan: 3D-printed in vitro sonication device: acoustic characterisation in water, no active ultrasound applied to cells (condition C).
papers.2022yamauchi: Airborne playback of ~50 kHz ultrasonic vocalisations into a rat cage (hypersonic effect), not a coupled transducer exposure (conditions B and C).
